Package fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp1.lombok

Class PersonLombokSecure

java.lang.Object
fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp1.lombok.PersonLombokSecure
public class PersonLombokSecure extends Object
Secure Lombok-backed Person: validation is performed at the factory/builder boundary.

This class demonstrates a recommended pattern when using Lombok: the public, validated static factory method of(String, String, int) is annotated with @Builder. Lombok generates a builder whose build() method delegates to this factory method; therefore both calls to PersonLombokSecure.of(...) and to the generated builder PersonLombokSecure.builder()...build() use the same validation and normalization logic implemented in of(...).

Implementation notes:

  • The all-args constructor is private (generated by Lombok with @AllArgsConstructor(access = AccessLevel.PRIVATE)), ensuring instances can only be created through the validated factory or the generated builder.
  • The factory performs lightweight validation (null checks, range checks) and normalization (e.g. String.strip()) before creating the instance. Validation uses Objects.requireNonNull(T) and throws IllegalArgumentException for invalid numeric values.
  • We intentionally avoid using @Data here to keep the example explicit; use @Data only when you want the convenience of generating getters/setters and other boilerplate in one go.
